title: Sales attribution
source: Sales Analysis · ERP_Sales_Data · Total Bill Amount (col 81, GST-inclusive) · source = Buyer_Source (col 115, customer-master lookup)

attributionModel.type: single-source (original/first-touch) — 100% of every invoice credited to the customer's recorded source
attributionModel.why: Buyer_Source is stored once per customer in the client master, so every invoice of a customer carries the same source. No touchpoint, lead, cost or spend data exists.
attributionModel.newCustomer: first-ever invoice (any category, own group companies excluded) falls inside the period. History starts 2025-06-02; new-customer figures for periods starting before 2025-12-01 are flagged newCustomersReliable=false (left-censored).
attributionModel.repeatRevenue: revenue in the period from customers whose first invoice was before the period.
attributionModel.aov: amount ÷ distinct invoices (invoice key = Invoice No With Prefix, else date#Invoice No; same as home.json).

definition.excludedBuyerMatch: case/punctuation-insensitive, leading M/S ignored (owncos.py), same as home.json
definition.categoryTabs: All / Labels (BarCode) / Gumming sheets (Sheet Form) / Roll form (Roll Form) / Other / misc (Other + blank + Label Sheet) — identical to home.json

normalisation.method: lowercase, punctuation→space, collapse spaces, trim; then map; blank → unknown; unseen spellings → other (listed in dataQuality.unmappedRaw)

unavailableMetrics.metric: Leads, conversion rate, win rate, revenue per lead
unavailableMetrics.reason: no lead/enquiry data (e.g. IndiaMART enquiries) in Sales Analysis
one source per customer; no touchpoint history

notes: Unknown (blank Buyer_Source) = ₹4.59 Cr lifetime (4.6% of GST-incl. sales), all from 1 customer(s): TECHNOVA PRINTRITE PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED.
'Other' is a recorded value but says nothing about the channel: ₹77.90 Cr lifetime (78.6%). Treat channel shares as indicative until Other is re-classified in the client master.

text: Amounts = Sales Analysis Total Bill Amount (col 81, GST-inclusive), line-level, summed. Never Taxable Value.
Excludes own group companies M/S SAL PAPERS PVT LTD and M/S SHREE ARIHANT LAMINATES everywhere. PFW included.
Current month is month-to-date through the last invoice (2026-10-08) and is shown as partial, same as #home.
Money values are numbers in ₹ lakh (…Lakh fields); format with fmtLakhINR (Cr at ≥ ₹1 crore, L below, Indian grouping).
CAC, ROI, leads and conversion are not available: there is no spend or lead data.
